name: Cabinet
description: A lightweight self-hosted file cabinet and document manager.
summary: Cabinet v0.4.4 (2026-05-23) is the largest release since v0.4.0, introducing Rooms (isolated workspaces), full internationalization across 40 locales with RTL support, an Integrations Hub for Slack/Discord/Google over MCP, and a mobile-responsive layout. v0.4.0 (2026-04-30) added a Skills system, multi-provider BYOAI runtime (8 CLI providers including Claude, Gemini, Codex), a terminal mode, and Tasks Board v2. The project was MIT licensed as of v0.4.0. Release notes are available at https://github.com/hilash/cabinet.

answers.Is the project actively maintained?: Yes — multiple releases in 2026, most recently v0.4.4 on 2026-05-23
answers.Does it support user authentication?: Not explicitly mentioned; there is a profile/onboarding flow and legal/ToS acceptance, but no formal auth system documented in the changelog

breaking_excerpts: Rooms migration: data/ is now a neutral 'home' container and each room is a top-level cabinet; the data root is no longer a working cabinet. Existing installs migrate automatically (data is backed up first).
Removed the status-bar page-scoped AI edit composer and the redundant task-page back buttons in favor of sidebar navigation.
cabinetai CLI refuses to bootstrap in $HOME or / and recommends ~/Documents/Cabinet.

alternatives.name: Paperless-ngx
alternatives.review: Paperless-ngx offers far more advanced document management with OCR and tagging but is significantly heavier and more complex to self-host than Cabinet.

alternatives.name: Teedy
alternatives.review: Teedy provides a polished document management UI with workflows and permissions but requires more resources and configuration compared to Cabinet.

alternatives.name: Filestash
alternatives.review: Filestash is a lightweight file manager supporting many storage backends but focuses on browsing files rather than document organization and metadata.

alternatives.name: Nextcloud
alternatives.review: Nextcloud is a comprehensive self-hosted platform with document management capabilities but is far heavier and more complex than a simple file cabinet solution.

alternatives.name: Docspell
alternatives.review: Docspell excels at automated document classification and OCR processing but has a steeper setup curve and heavier footprint compared to Cabinet.
